response.title: Sweet Dinner Rolls
response.description: Dinner rolls have got to be my favourite bread type. I love the Asian inspired sweet and fluffy milk bread rolls especially. This Dinner Rolls recipe is amazing, even if I do say so myself. If done properly, you’ll end up very soft and chewy roll which stay soft for days. Remember, this recipe is for “Sweet” Dinner Rolls, so if you’re not a fan of sweet bread, be sure to reduce the quantity of sugar in the recipe. I prefer my Dinner Rolls sweet so I can snack on it on its own rather than as a meal accompaniment.

evidence.excerpt: 500g Strong Bread Flour
50g Butter
90g Sugar
3 Tablespoons Milk Powder (Optional)
280ml Milk ( If you’re using evaporated milk, be sure to dilute with water first as it’s quite thick)
11g Active Dry Yeast
2 Eggs
1/2 Teaspoon Salt

steps.text: You can use the dough tool on your stand mixer for this, you’ll need to knead for 2-3 minutes. If you’re kneading by hand, mix till thoroughly combined. You should get a smooth stretchy dough. Now, add in the Butter, mix thoroughly…

steps.text: When it’s fully combined, you should get a very smooth and elastic dough. The dough should not stick to your hands or fingers. Place the dough into an oiled bowl and place in a warm place, preferably your oven. You can place a cup of hot water underneath to help with the fermentation.
